# pcd_networking_subnet (Resource)

Manages a subnet on a Neutron network in PCD.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `network_id` (String) The network this subnet belongs to. Changing this forces a new resource.

### Optional

- `allocation_pools` (Attributes List) IP allocation pools (DHCP ranges). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--allocation_pools))
- `cidr` (String) The CIDR of the subnet. Changing this forces a new resource.
- `description` (String) A description of the subnet.
- `dns_nameservers` (List of String) DNS nameservers for the subnet.
- `enable_dhcp` (Boolean) Whether DHCP is enabled for the subnet.
- `gateway_ip` (String) The gateway IP. Defaults to the first address in the CIDR.
- `ip_version` (Number) IP version (4 or 6).
- `name` (String) The name of the subnet.
- `region` (String) The region. Defaults to the provider's region.
- `tags` (Set of String) Tags applied to the subnet.
- `tenant_id` (String) The owning project. Changing this forces a new resource.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The subnet ID.

<a id="nestedatt--allocation_pools"></a>
### Nested Schema for `allocation_pools`

Required:

- `end` (String) Last address of the pool.
- `start` (String) First address of the pool.
